label: Produced because of its goodness: favouring depends on betterness with D-realization fixed
term: because of its goodness (controlled goodness reading)
definition: BecauseOfGoodness good fitOf φ s x y is DependsUnder good fitOf φ s x y: the source favours x over y at s, and in some scenario with the same realization of D (fitOf) where the betterness standard does not rank x over y, the source does not favour x over y. A source determined to D fails; a good-general source tracking betterness passes, whatever the bearer.
note: Analyst reading BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2. It needs scenarios in which goodness varies while D-realization is fixed; if goodness facts are necessary given the candidates, those scenarios are counterpossible, and without them no profile aligned with goodness meets this reading (GoodDependenceLaws law 4). See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
